items.name: Recorder by Alex
items.tagline: Camera video and audio recorder with a live HLS dashboard served by the phone.
items.description: A camera-first video and audio recorder. The phone serves a live HLS stream to any browser on the same network, so there is no backend and no cloud round trip. Built with Kotlin, CameraX and Media3.

items.name: Photo Editor by Alex
items.tagline: Offline photo editor with layers, grading, cutouts and background removal.
items.description: Offline photo editor with background removal, colour grading, layers, crop, text, drawing and cutouts. Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, no account and no upload — the photos never leave the device.

items.name: 4 Games by Alex
items.tagline: Chess with Stockfish 19, Flappy Bird, Virtual Pet 3D and Horizon.
items.description: Four offline, ad-free games in one app: Chess running the real Stockfish 19 engine, Flappy Bird, Virtual Pet 3D and Horizon.

items.name: Project Alice
items.tagline: Victoria 2 running natively on Android through the Project Alice engine.
items.description: The open-source Project Alice engine compiled for ARM64, running Victoria 2 natively on Android with OpenGL ES 3.2. A desktop-class grand strategy game in your pocket.
items.caveat: Requires your own copy of Victoria 2. Game assets are not included.

items.name: DoL by Alex
items.tagline: Degrees of Lewdity, the interactive fiction game, fully offline.
items.description: An Android port of Degrees of Lewdity, the SugarCube/Twine interactive fiction game, migrated twice and shipped as a fully offline app. Community fork; attribution to the upstream project is required.

items.name: Alex Store
items.tagline: The Android app for the storefront, with semantic search running on device.
items.description: The Android app for shahzadp.github.io/store: a static storefront with no backend, semantic search running natively through Rust and dart:ffi, and a launch film that plays over the app.

items.name: Portfolio
items.tagline: The portfolio PWA: selected projects, CV and contact, installable from your browser.
items.description: The portfolio as a progressive web app: selected projects, a CV download, education and contact links. It opens in your browser so Android can install it as a standalone app; the manager keeps no copy of the site.
